title: 1948 Volunteer Firmen First Day Of Issue Stamp Scotts #971 - Used On Envelope
descriptionText: The product is a 1948 Volunteer Firmen First Day of Issue stamp from the United States, specifically Scotts #971. This stamp was used on an envelope, making it a unique and collectible piece. As a First Day of Issue stamp, it holds historical significance and value for stamp collectors interested in pre-1951 United States postage. The cancellation type adds to the authenticity and rarity of the item, making it a sought-after piece for enthusiasts of philately.
